raw_description:
An adult emperor penguin outcast, front view, tall and lean with a
long straight beak, standing slightly hunched in a solitary posture.
Enveloped in a simple hooded cloak in a muted neutral color that
drapes from the head to the feet. One plain walking stave held at
the side. Saturated colored belly peeking out, dark body.
formatted_prompt:
STYLE: flat modern app icon; bold vector geometry; centered single subject on plain off-white canvas; SF Symbols Filled register; crisp sharp edges readable at 16px; no gradients, no textures, no painterly marks

SUBJECT: adult emperor penguin, tall and lean with narrow pointed beak, small dark eyes proportional to skull, upright but slightly hunched solitary posture, front view; draped in a full hooded cloak falling from crown to feet in flat warm neutral tone (#FFFFFF tinted warm gray); saturated vivid yellow-orange belly patch visible where cloak parts at center (#FF6600); sleek dark body (#000000) visible at face and feet; one plain vertical walking stave held at the side, rendered as a clean rectangular rod in flat black

CONTEXT: isolated icon subject, no background scene, generous padding around figure, plain off-white canvas

COLOR: cloak in warm light gray-white (#FFFFFF); belly accent in bold orange (#FF6600); body and beak in flat black (#000000); stave in flat black (#000000); eye as a small white dot on black; hood interior shadow as a single flat dark shape

DETAILS: every edge crisp and deliberate; cloak rendered as three flat shapes — hood ovoid, left drape, right drape; belly as one centered elliptical flat shape; stave as a single slim vertical rectangle; no brush marks, no ink texture, no aging

CONSTRAINTS: adult anatomical proportions strictly enforced; no cartoon or juvenile features; no oversized eyes; no scene elements; no frame or border
